text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 5.Official high school or middle school transcript 6.Two letters of recommendation From teachers familiar with the applicant's scholastic aptitude and general character
